summary: Brenmiller Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Annual and Special General Meeting of Shareholders, originally convened on July 29, 2026, was adjourned due to lack of quorum. The adjourned meeting reconvened later that day, achieved a quorum, and shareholders approved all agenda items as detailed in the prior proxy statement. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine procedural update concerning shareholder meeting results, not a special situation. The filing is incorporated by reference into multiple shelf registration statements.
